mapper.select: SELECT ri.id as queueId, ri.project_name as queueName, ri.research_status as queueStatus, pi.patient_status as patientStatus, (select count(*) from quit_record qr where qr.research_id = ri.id and qr.person_id = pi.person_id and is_agree is null) as noAuditCount, (select count(*) from quit_record qr where qr.research_id = ri.id and qr.person_id = pi.person_id and is_agree = 1) as agreeCount FROM patient_info pi left join research_info ri on ri.id = pi.research_id where ri.research_status != 0 and pi.enrollment_status = 1 and pi.person_id = #{personId} and pi.enrollment_handler_status = 3 order by ri.create_time desc
